arStrings.szText: Harness the power of the {icon:Marker_X2_Cube - Cube Icon}{c_highlight}Horadric Cube{/c} to transmute items and materials.
The {c_highlight}Cube{/c} is the foundation of transmutation. You can select a {c_highlight}recipe{/c} to {c_highlight}Transmute{/c} items.
Try different {c_highlight}recipe{/c} combinations to create the {c_highlight}most powerful{/c} item!

Transmutations can be influenced by {c_highlight}Tuning Prisms{/c}. They are found around {c_highlight}Sanctuary{/c} and stored in your {icon:Inventory_Tab_Icon_Consumables_Selected,2}{c_highlight}Consumables{/c} tab.
